name: Entelligence AI
tagline: Reviews PRs on GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket with codebase and team context, plus CLI pre-PR review and engineering metrics.
pricing: Now published: Startup $750/mo (up to 15 engineers, 300 reviews/mo then $1/review); Scale $2,500/mo (16-50 engineers, 1,000 reviews/mo then $1/review); Enterprise custom (adds Agent Insights, Model Router, Knowledge Base, self-hosting)
selfHostedNote: Self-hosting is listed as an Enterprise-plan inclusion on the pricing page (not available on Startup/Scale); deploy in your own cloud with your own provider keys.
modelControl: BYOK documented for Model Router (AWS Bedrock, OpenRouter); model choice for Code Review itself not documented

01-multi-dimensional-context.note: Docs: reviews each PR with the codebase, team guidance, prior feedback, and connected context in view.

02-rule-centric.note: Guidelines per repo/language/path, generated from review history; confidence thresholds and comment limits.

03-dual-workflow.note: CLI runs the review engine on local diffs before the PR opens; documented IDE extension page is unverified.

04-business-logic.note: Jira/Linear/Notion/Confluence connectors and MCP documented; ticket-vs-PR validation not explicit for review.

05-continuous-learning.note: Learnings capture team-confirmed exceptions; prior feedback is a documented input to future reviews.

06-sandbox-validation.note: No documented sandbox execution or test-run validation.

07-economic-transparency.note: Markets BYOK, self-hosted, no token markup; per-seat pricing now published (Startup/Scale plus $1/review overage); BYOK documented only for Model Router (AWS Bedrock, OpenRouter), Enterprise-only.

08-actionability.note: Findings ship a ready-made fix prompt for Claude Code/Cursor; no one-click committable suggestions documented.

09-measurable-roi.note: Documented metrics: comment acceptance, cycle time, and DORA (deploy frequency, lead time, CFR, MTTR).
